source: To be fair, you've appeared with people across the Democratic spectrum, and you shouldn't ignore your Southern base completely.
zh: 公平地说，你与民主党派别的人一起出现过，你不应该完全忽视你的南方基地。

source: This might be true, but there are more people in your Party opposed to Wallace than supportive of him.
zh: 这可能是真的，但你们党内反对华莱士的人多于支持他的人。

source: This might play well in the South, but it definitely detracts from your national appeal.
zh: 这可能在南方很受欢迎，但它肯定会降低你在全国的吸引力。

source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. The least you can do is show some contrition.
zh: 首先进行这次采访是一个坏主意。你至少可以做的是表现出一些悔悟。

source: It's probably smart to cut your losses and move on from this issue. But for the first time now, a lot of people are questioning your judgment...
zh: 减少损失并继续解决这个问题可能是明智之举。但现在第一次，很多人质疑你的判断……

source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. You don't need to make things worse by digging your heels in.
zh: 首先进行这次采访是一个坏主意。你不需要固执己见，让事情变得更糟。

source: You've gained a bit for being honest, but this can't be good for your chances in Texas.
zh: 你因诚实而获得了一些好处，但这对你在得克萨斯州中的机会不利。

source: Probably a smart move to walk back from these comments, although it does undermine your claims to honesty by a small amount.
zh: 放弃这些评论可能是明智之举，尽管它确实会稍微削弱您的诚实主张。

source: Unfortunately there's not much you can do with this awkward situation. But you've spoken out enough for Civil Rights that this shouldn't hurt you too much...
zh: 不幸的是，对于这种尴尬的情况你无能为力。但你已经为民权说得够多了，这不会对你造成太大伤害......

source: This answer sounds too strident and waffling to have much appeal on either side. Hopefully the damage is limited.
zh: 这个答案听起来太尖锐和含糊其辞，对任何一方都没有多大吸引力。希望伤害是有限的。

source: It's nice to talk about the New South, but there is sure to be a backlash (especially from the Southern Baptist vote). On the other hand, this could help you a bit elsewhere.
zh: 很高兴谈论新南方，但肯定会出现强烈反对（尤其是美南浸信会投票）。另一方面，这可以在其他方面对您有所帮助。

source: Walter Mondale is a popular choice among mainstream Democrats.
zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔是主流民主党人的热门选择。

source: This is a strong answer, but it certainly helps you with the Jewish vote in New York and elsewhere.
zh: 这是一个强有力的答案，但它肯定会对您在纽约州和其他地方的犹太人投票有所帮助。

source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish supporters were hoping for more.
zh: 这是一个足够好的答案，但一些犹太支持者希望得到更多。

source: Your position on this controversy has become news itself. People are wondering if you're opposed to Israel or the Jewish people, and it is not helping you on the trial.
zh: 你在这场争议中的立场本身已经成为新闻。人们想知道你是否反对以色列或犹太人民，这对你的审判没有帮助。

source: This is a good liberal answer, but perhaps a bit too liberal.
zh: 这是一个很好的自由主义答案，但也许有点太自由主义了。

source: This is not the best response for a Democrat.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这不是最好的回应。

source: This is a controversial answer, but as an outsider it could help feed your popularity.
zh: 这是一个有争议的答案，但作为局外人，它可以帮助提高你的人气。

source: This is the mainstream answer shared by all major politicians (unless you count a guy like Reagan).
zh: 这是所有主要政客共享的主流答案（除非你算上像里根这样的人）。

source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. Some wings of the party are pretty disappointed in this stance.
zh: 甚至杰拉尔德·福特也支持该修正案。该党的一些派别对这一立场感到非常失望。

source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. It's good to win the labor vote, but there are other factors to consider as well.
zh: 甚至杰拉尔德·福特也支持该修正案。赢得工党选票固然很好，但还有其他因素需要考虑。

source: Busing is not a popular policy, but to come out so strongly against it offends some in your party.
zh: 乘坐公交车并不是一项受欢迎的政策，但如此强烈地反对它会冒犯党内的一些人。

source: You've taken the same position as Ford on this issue. But it is probably the majority view at this time.
zh: 您在这个问题上采取了与福特相同的立场。但这可能是目前大多数人的观点。

source: You've offended nobody, but also pleased nobody. There are whispers from some that you can't take a stand on any important issue.
zh: 你没有冒犯任何人，但也没有取悦任何人。有些人私下说你不能在任何重要问题上表明立场。

source: This issue divides your party, and you've cast your lot very clearly. Let's see what happens.
zh: 这个问题分裂了你们的政党，你们的命运已经非常明确了。让我们看看会发生什么。

source: On the balance, your party is surprised to hear you take this stance.
zh: 总的来说，你的政党对你采取这种立场感到惊讶。

source: This is a good, safe answer on the topic.
zh: 这是关于该主题的一个很好、安全的答案。

source: What you've said is true, but you've certainly staked out a liberal position on the issue.
zh: 你所说的是真的，但你在这个问题上肯定表明了自由主义立场。

source: This is another hot-button issue where it might be better for a Democrat to hedge a little.
zh: 这是另一个热点问题，民主党人最好稍微对冲一下。

source: It's hard to know what to do with this question. It might well be best to give a non-committal answer and hope the issue goes away after this election.
zh: 很难知道如何处理这个问题。最好给出一个不置可否的答案，并希望这个问题在这次选举后消失。

source: Some in your party are glad to hear this, but it is also an unpopular position in the South.
zh: 你们党内的一些人很高兴听到这个消息，但这在南方也是一个不受欢迎的立场。

source: Voters don't care much what you do, as long as there are no more gas shortages and long lines at the pump.
zh: 选民不太关心你做什么，只要不再出现天然气短缺和加油站排长队的情况。

source: This certainly helps you with the urban hard hat vote, but it could hurt you in the South, where most states are right-to-work.
zh: 这当然可以帮助您进行城市安全帽投票，但它可能会伤害您在南方的大部分州工作权。

source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large wing of the party.
zh: 这是一种中间立场的答案，可以防止你疏远党内的任何大派别。

source: This is a big break from the Democratic platform. You'd better be prepared to explain this a little more.
zh: 这是民主党政纲的重大突破。你最好准备好对此进行更多解释。

source: You've definitely come down with the dovish wing of the party on this issue.
zh: 在这个问题上，你肯定是支持党内的鸽派人士的。

source: This is a popular, mainstream answer on this issue. Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days.
zh: 这是关于这个问题的流行、主流答案。如今，就连共和党人也在寻找缓解冷战紧张局势的方法。

source: You've definitely come down with the hawkish wing of the party on this issue.
zh: 在这个问题上，你肯定是支持了党内的鹰派。

source: This answer is a bit apathetic, and you've missed a good chance to win support from the farm states.
zh: 这个答案有点冷漠，你错过了赢得农场州支持的好机会。

source: A lot of farm states are happy to have another market for their grain, and this is a good foreign policy win as well.
zh: 许多农业州很高兴他们的粮食有另一个市场，这也是外交政策的一个很好的胜利。

source: This might make you look more conservative, but it's not the popular answer for this election.
zh: 这可能会让你看起来更保守，但这不是这次选举的流行答案。

source: McGovern lost pretty badly in '72, if you'll remember. It might not the best strategy to copy his policies.
zh: 如果你还记得的话，麦戈文在 72 年输得很惨。复制他的政策可能不是最好的策略。

source: This a good way to please your liberal base without associating yourself with the McGovern disaster.
zh: 这是一个取悦你的自由派基础的好方法，而又不会让你自己与麦戈文灾难联系在一起。

source: This is not a good way to win support from the Democrats in 1976.
zh: 这不是 1976 年赢得民主党支持的好方法。

source: This is a dovish answer, but one that many Americans agree with.
zh: 这是一个温和的答案，但许多美国人都同意。

source: This puts you at odds with the Democratic Party, but it could help you with the defense hawk types.
zh: 这会让你与民主党产生矛盾，但它可以帮助你处理防御鹰类型。

source: Americans, and particularly Democrats, do not want a President who sounds like this on the Vietnam issue. Let bygones be bygones.
zh: 美国人，尤其是民主党人，不想要一位在越南问题上听起来如此的总统。过去的就让它过去吧。

source: This is a pretty liberal policy, but it's broadly popular with Democrats and particularly important to Hubert Humphrey.
zh: 这是一项相当自由的政策，但它广泛受到民主党人的欢迎，对休伯特来说尤其重要汉弗莱。

source: This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty, but many Democrats favor the proposed law.
zh: 这是一个很好的机会来展示自己作为常识和诚实的声音，但许多民主党人赞成拟议的法律。

source: You have enjoyed broad appeal, but sometimes it is almost too broad. As the election approaches, some voters worry that you can't take a clear stand on many of the issues.
zh: 你享有广泛的吸引力，但有时它几乎太广泛了。随着选举的临近，一些选民担心你无法在许多问题上采取明确的立场。

source: This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat. It sounds like something Ronald Reagan might say.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这是一个相当保守的答案。听起来像是罗纳德·里根可能会说的话。

source: This is a pretty standard answer for a Democrat. Of course, if you're elected, liberals in the party (such as Ted Kennedy) will expect you to take action on this issue.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这是一个非常标准的答案。当然，如果你当选，党内的自由派（例如特德·肯尼迪）会期望你在这个问题上采取行动。

source: This is another answer that offends nobody, but also pleases nobody.
zh: 这是另一个不会冒犯任何人的答案，但也不会取悦任何人。

source: This is not inspiring stuff to the Democratic base.
zh: 这对民主党基础来说并不是鼓舞人心的东西。

source: Even Ford is less opposed to health care measures than this. You've taken a pretty conservative stance here.
zh: 就连福特也比这更反对医疗保健措施。你在这里采取了相当保守的立场。

source: This is a good, liberal answer, but a bit outside the mainstream.
zh: 这是一个很好、自由的答案，但有点脱离主流。

source: The party has a little more of a nuanced position on this issue.
zh: 该党在这个问题上的立场更加微妙。

source: Settle in and wait for the returns. Hopefully you can hold on for the win!
zh: 安顿下来并等待选举结果。希望你能坚持下去，争取胜利！

source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish voters were hoping for more.
zh: 这是一个足够好的答案，但一些犹太选民希望得到更多。

source: This is not the kind of answer that Republicans want to hear.
zh: 这不是共和党人想听到的答案。

source: Some accuse you of flip-flopping after you decided to bail out New York. It's good to emphasize that they passed reforms first.
zh: 有些人指责你在决定保释后反复无常纽约州。值得强调的是，他们首先通过了改革。

source: This would be a good answer, but unfortunately you signed off on the New York bailout. It will take some tortuous logic to explain how this position is consistent with that act.
zh: 这将是一个很好的答案，但不幸的是您签署了纽约州救助计划。需要一些曲折的逻辑来解释这一立场与该法案如何一致。

source: This is not a popular answer with Republicans.
zh: 这不是共和党人普遍接受的答案。

source: You've definitely enjoyed a day of generally positive press coverage with this stance. But behind the scenes, conservatives and veterans are upset.
zh: 你肯定很享受这一天的普遍积极的媒体报道与这种立场。但在幕后，保守派和退伍军人却感到不安。

source: This is the party line, but it's also a controversial issue with much disagreement.
zh: 这是党的路线，但也是一个有争议的问题，分歧很大。

source: This is a good compromise position if you don't want to support the Amendment.
zh: 如果您不想支持该修正案，这是一个很好的折衷立场。

source: This is a good answer to fire up the base. But women voters, including your own wife, are upset with you. Enjoy sleeping on the White House couch for a few days.
zh: 这是一个启动基地的好答案。但女性选民，包括你自己的妻子，对你感到不满。享受在白宫沙发上睡几天的感觉。

source: You've managed to offend everyone with this answer. Sounding conservative and praising labor unions at the same time?
zh: 你的这个答案已经冒犯了所有人。听起来很保守，同时又赞扬工会？

source: Busing is not a popular policy, and there's not that much to lose by coming out against it.
zh: 乘坐公交车并不是一项受欢迎的政策，而且站出来反对也不会造成太大损失。

source: Busing is a pretty unpopular policy, and even more so in your party.
zh: 乘坐公交车是一项非常不受欢迎的政策，在你们的聚会中更是如此。

source: This is a standard, Republican position.
zh: 这是标准的共和党立场。

source: In this day and age, this might be the best stance. Voters like the fact that we're not at war right now.
zh: 在当今时代，这可能是最好的立场。选民喜欢我们现在没有处于战争状态这一事实。

source: You're really thinking outside the box for a Republican. But there will be a backlash.
zh: 你真的是在跳出共和党人的思维框架。但会有反弹。

source: There has been a lot of debate in your party on this issue, but allowing each state to make their own decision is a good compromise, right?
zh: 你们党内对此问题进行了很多辩论，但允许每个州做出自己的决定是一个很好的妥协，对吗？

source: You've come out more strongly in favor of abortion than Carter, or even McGovern did. You're definitely making headlines today.
zh: 你比卡特更强烈地支持堕胎，甚至比麦戈文也更强烈。你今天肯定会成为头条新闻。
